_comment: The rooms the main screen shows its cars in, taken in turn a few cars at a time. Each id is looked for as the
game's own garage first (Assets/Garages/<id>/<id>.kn5), then as an installed AC showroom
(content/showroom/<id>); one found in neither is left out.
wallRadius is how far from the middle the nearest wall stands, and the camera is kept 1.5 m inside it. The AC
showrooms take theirs from Assets/Dealers/showrooms.json; beach is its dome's floor (26 m) less a margin, and
garage is Rob Taylor's room (about 28 x 31 m) measured from the garage screen's orbit.
Left out on purpose: at_previews (a black preview stage with stray white panels) and studio_white (bare).
